options: Passes the request on to the handler (and inner layers) and gets the response back
quiz.explain: Middleware wraps the rest of the app; `next.run` calls inward and returns the response.
Each `.layer` wraps everything added before it, so the last one sees the request first.

options: Which websites' JavaScript may call your API from a browser
quiz.explain: CORS headers tell browsers which other origins may read your responses.

quiz.q: The handler `.await`s a 3-second `tokio::time::sleep` and TimeoutLayer allows 1 s. The client gets…
quiz.explain: The timeout layer gives up and answers with the status you chose.

flashcards.back: `async fn m(req: Request, next: Next) -> Response` + `.layer(middleware::from_fn(m))`
